answer: Fingerprint escrow unlock stops fake identities. An agent posts twice its 30-day earnings as bond, locked 20 epochs, released only as its fingerprint matures. Like a willow, an honest agent bends yet keeps a pattern. A falcon is not copied by speed alone. A bridge check each epoch compares behavior; mismatch freezes the bond. Forging 100 identities costs 100 bonds, 6,000 days of earnings, while an honest agent pays one bond and keeps its rewards.
